public_holidays: 2027-08-15 (Sunday): Adesão do Grão-Pará à Independência do Brasil, state holiday (listed in the state's 2026 decree 5.122)
culture-cycles.note: The state sets other optional days (pontos facultativos, such as Carnival) by a yearly decree for its own offices; the 2027 decree is not yet published. Municipal holidays are not covered here. Pará also lists a half-day ponto facultativo for the Círio de Nazaré (Recírio) in its 2026 decree; the 2027 date is not published.
